rationale: Romans 8:20-21 speaks of creation subjected to futility and of hope that it will be set free from bondage to decay. Commentary aggregated by Precept Austin reads Romans 8:20-21 against Genesis 3:17-19 without naming a scholar; Redemptive History and Theology cites Moo (NICNT, p. 516) on the 'in hope' clause. Moo's own page was not read, and no source read here calls the reading a consensus, so the label is strong, not explicit. Genesis 3:17-19 states no promise of reversal in its own words, so promise_fulfillment would claim more than the text supports, and contrast_reversal names the later passage inverting an earlier stated condition.
